description: This file provides utility functions for managing local heavy check runtime operations, such as environment configuration, lock management, and process synchronization in a Node.js environment, specifically for a project related to 'local-heavy-check'.

methods.name: isLocalCheckEnabled
methods.description: Checks if local checking is enabled based on environment variable 'OPENCLAW_LOCAL_CHECK'.

methods.name: hasFlag
methods.description: Determines if a specific flag is present in the argument list.

methods.name: applyLocalTsgoPolicy
methods.description: Adjusts environment variables and arguments for local tsgo policy based on environment configuration.

methods.name: applyLocalOxlintPolicy
methods.description: Adjusts arguments for local oxlint policy depending on environment setting.

methods.name: acquireLocalHeavyCheckLockSync
methods.description: Synchronously acquires a lock for heavy local checks, managing lock files and handling timeouts and lock reclamation.

methods.name: resolveGitCommonDir
methods.description: Resolves the common directory of a git repository in the given current working directory.
